{{Top|leg}}
A '''data retrieval spike''' was a long spike that retrieved data. It could be worked into the hand of a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], disguised as a finger. One of these was used unconventionally by [[Vlaçan Umber]]'s [[Umber 3PO unit|3PO unit]] to [[Death/Legends|murder]] the famed [[Artist/Legends|artist]] [[Ves Volette]].
